handoff.salientSummary: Implemented F1.5 repo test scaffolding: pytest/ruff/mypy config, shellcheck/yamllint configs, --help banners and bash version preflight on all engine scripts, pre-boot fixture validation, scenario id collision detection, sweep-scenarios.sh (check-jsonschema), orphan-audit.sh, and comprehensive bats+pytest tests. All 81 bats tests and 71 pytest tests pass; all milestone gate commands (lint/typecheck/test) exit 0.
handoff.whatWasImplemented:
F1.5 repo test scaffolding with the following components:

1. **pyproject.toml** — Added dev deps (pytest, ruff, mypy, types-PyYAML), check-jsonschema runtime dep, mypy strict=true config with jinja2 ignore_missing_imports override
2. **.yamllint** — Root yamllint config with relaxed rules for helm values (line-length 200, document-start disable, truthy relaxed)
3. **.shellcheckrc** — Root shellcheck config disabling SC1091, SC2155, SC2001, SC2005
4. **All 10 engine scripts** — Added usage() function with --help BEFORE BASH_VERSINFO preflight (so --help works under bash 3.2 on macOS)
5. **run-scenario.sh** — Added validate_fixture_paths() for pre-boot fixture path validation (names scenario id, preinstall index, missing path) and scenario id collision detection with deterministic suffix
6. **sweep-scenarios.sh** — New script using check-jsonschema CLI for cross-scenario schema validation (only scans */scenarios/ directories)
7. **orphan-audit.sh** — New script auditing chart-test-swarm-* kind clusters, minikube profiles, docker containers with --fix cleanup mode
8. **bats tests** — 3 new test files: help-banner.bats (11 tests), bash-version-preflight.bats (6 tests), orphan-invariant.bats (2 tests)
9. **pytest test_scaffolding.py** — 53 test cases covering ruff, mypy, cluster name defaults, help banners, bash preflight, sweep tool, orphan audit, fixture validation, collision detection, pyproject.toml config
10. **Fixed existing tests** — cluster-lifecycle.bats updated for bash 3.2 compatibility (tests prefix-check library directly under bash 3.2, falls back to source code inspection)
11. **Fixed yamllint errors** — 5 scenario YAML files had extra spaces after commas
12. **Removed unnecessary BASH_VERSINFO preflight** from sweep-scenarios.sh (no bash 4+ features used)
